proposal_source: Master Equation River v1.6 (Appendix C follow-up), building on v1.5 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22550491 (concept 22414412)
extractor_note: Resolves all 24 equations v1.5's own Appendix C lists as carrying no Toledo code (\eqref{eq:15}, \eqref{eq:32}-\eqref{eq:37}, \eqref{eq:39}-\eqref{eq:52}, \eqref{eq:65}, \eqref{eq:66}, \eqref{eq:79}). Method: for each equation, read its own statement in v1.5's main.tex verbatim, then screen registry/CANONICAL.json for a structurally identical existing entry under the phi-criterion (bijective renaming / fixed positive scale / fixed constant substitution, no limits or approximations, per docs/EQ_CODE_SCHEME.md's Equivalence Registry criterion) by keyword/substring search on the candidate constructs' own symbols and names, followed by a manual read of the closest matches. This is a keyword/substring screen, not an exhaustive machine-checked equivalence search over all 1,264 entries -- 'no existing entry found' for the three genuinely new proposals below is a Dr-tier readout of this screen, not a proof of non-existence. Three of the 24 (eq.44, eq.66, eq.79) were already hand-identified by registry/COLLAPSE.md sec.2 ('manual, verified textual match') against the root spine (CAN-004/CAN-003, CAN-201/CAN-006, CAN-006); those three are carried into this file as occurrence_proposals unchanged from COLLAPSE.md's own identification, not re-derived here. Root assignment for the remaining 21 follows Section 10 (sec:one-eq-segments) of v1.5 where that section names the root for the segment; where Section 10 states only 'no Toledo code yet' without naming a root, the root is taken from the phi-criterion match itself (this changed the working assumption from EQ-015 to weld for eq.33-eq.36 and to A.5 for eq.42/eq.47-eq.49, since those equations' exact-match existing entries sit under those roots, not EQ-015). Registrar note: this file proposes (i) new occurrences to append to EXISTING entries' own `occurrences` arrays (registry/SCHEMA.md field `occurrences`), and (ii) three wholly new reading entries for constructs with no existing Toledo code. No CANONICAL.json file was edited to produce this file.

proposals.name: River-summary narrative closure: experience, the changed reader, possibility, choice, action, and the re-read world

statement.latest: \text{Experience changes the reader; the changed reader changes what can become possible; what becomes possible changes choice; choice changes action and the world; the changed world is read again.}

statements_history.statement: \text{Experience changes the reader; the changed reader changes what can become possible; what becomes possible changes choice; choice changes action and the world; the changed world is read again.}
statements_history.reason: master-river-v1.6-extractor: captured from Master Equation River v1.5, eq.45 (Conclusion). No existing Toledo entry found stating this exact five-step prose closure under the phi-criterion (keyword screen for 'changed reader', 'changes what can become possible', 'reader changes' found no match); it restates, in one narrative sentence, the same root-level architecture (retained difference before naming; readout/meaning/experience ordering; agency as readout-action loop) that v1.5's own Section 9 ledger (tab:status, 'Root / inherited architecture' row) already attributes to the river's foundation, so it is filed as a reading of the root stepper (EQ-015/M.02.v1) rather than a new claim.

parents.evidence: "After reviewing the whole corpus, what the Master Equation River reveals is not that every paper says the same thing, but that each paper fills a missing layer of the same process. The overall picture is [eq.45]" (v1.5 sec:conclusion1, line 763-765)

proposals.provenance_note_verbatim: "Experience changes the reader; the changed reader changes what can become possible; what becomes possible changes choice; choice changes action and the world; the changed world is read again."
proposals.drift_note: This is a prose (non-symbolic) restatement of the root stepper's own recursive readout/meaning/experience/agency chain rather than an equation in the algebraic sense; filed at Definition tier, no tier raised, and no independent verification of the narrative claim is asserted beyond what v1.5's own Section 9 ledger already states about the root.
